announcements.headline: Interim Results, Share Issue and TVR
announcements.insight: The combination of interim results with a share issue suggests capital raising to support lending growth in the high-interest alternative finance sector, while TVR indicates active management of loan-to-value ratios amid tightening credit conditions.

announcements.headline: Directorate Change, Trading & Bond Issue
announcements.insight: The combination of a new director appointment with a bond issue suggests active capital restructuring to support lending growth in the current high-rate environment, indicating strategic expansion rather than mere administrative change.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: This is a standard administrative filing confirming the outcome of the Annual General Meeting, which typically involves routine matters like director reappointments and auditor ratification rather than strategic shifts or capital raises.
